title: workload-signature-batcher-synthesizer-and-safe-deploy
creator: Maya Patel
description:
Objective: Build a synthesizer that generates per-workload batching recommendations by extracting a compact workload signature, ranking safe batching candidates with heuristics, and continuously tuning parameters with shadow evaluation and automated safe-apply/rollback.

Background: We have many tickets and prototypes focusing on batching heuristics and continuous tuning. Customers running mix workloads show large tail-cost variance; manual config is error-prone. This ticket aims to centralize profiling, produce deterministic candidate configs, and provide an automated path to apply recommendations with conservative safety checks and fast rollback on regressions.

Goals:
- Define a compact workload signature that captures request size distribution, concurrency pattern, KV cache hit-rate, and model latency shape.
- Produce ranked batching/caching candidate configs (batch_size, max_delay_ms, prefetch_parallelism, kv_cache_ttl) per signature with confidence buckets.
- Run candidates in shadow for 24–72h and evaluate cost vs latency vs quality tradeoffs.
- Provide an automated safe-apply path: staged canary -> ramp -> global, with automated rollback triggers.
- Surface clear telemetry & audit trail in Console for each recommendation and applied change.

Design approach:
1) Workload profiling: streaming aggregator that computes sliding histograms for token counts, inter-arrival times (IAT), concurrency heatmap, per-model KV cache reuse rates, and downstream service backpressure signals. Profiles are sharded by model+route+customer and distilled into a deterministic signature hash.

2) Candidate generation: rules engine seeded with empirically validated heuristics (e.g., prefer microbatching for high IAT singletons, larger batches for steady streams) plus an enumeration of safe parameter ranges derived from runtime capacity constraints. Each candidate is scored along three axes: estimated token-cost reduction, p95 latency delta, and confidence (profile support).

3) Shadow validation: candidates are executed in shadow mode with exact request duplication (no effect on production outputs) for a configurable window. We compute per-candidate metrics: token cost delta, p50/p95 latency, tail error rate, and quality deltas for a sampled eval prompt set (approx 1000 prompts/day).

4) Safe apply orchestration:
- Phase 0: Recommend (Console visible).
- Phase 1: Canary (1% traffic, 1 hour).
- Phase 2: Progressive ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100% with time windows).
- Phase 3: Monitor hold (48h).
Rollback triggers (automated):
- absolute p95 latency increase > 30% or +300ms (whichever smaller) sustained for a window
- error rate (5xx) increase > 2x baseline or >0.5% absolute
- quality regression on eval set: statistically significant drop in correct-classification/score at alpha=0.01
- token-cost increase > 5%
Automatic rollback must be executed within a synthesis TTL and produce an auditable change log and reason.

Acceptance criteria:
- Signature generation implemented and stored; signatures stable for identical workload over 48h
- Candidate generator produces at least 3 ranked configs per signature with estimated metrics
- Shadow validation pipeline operates across 5 diverse internal customer workloads and produces dashboards
- Safe-apply flow implemented with canary/ramp/rollback hooks and an opt-out toggle per-customer
- End-to-end test harness reproduces a staged rollout and triggers an automated rollback on injected regression

Telemetry & observability:
- New Console views: recommendation list, candidate scorecards, rollout timeline, and audit log entries
- Metric slices: token_cost_per_request, p50/p95_latency, kv_cache_hit_rate, error_rate, quality_eval_score
- Alerts: automatic Slack alert to oncall + owner when rollback occurs

Implementation tasks (high level):
- profiling: streaming aggregator + signature distiller (backend infra) (2w)
- candidate engine: heuristics rules + param enumerator (1.5w)
- shadow runner: request duplicator + metric collector (2w)
- safe-apply orchestrator: rollout engine, rollback automation, audit logs (2w)
- console UI: recommendation UX and candidate drilldown (1.5w)
- e2e tests and chaos injection harness (1w)

Risks & mitigations:
- risk: signature churn causing flapping recommendations -> mitigation: signature smoothing window + stable-hash policy
- risk: silent quality regressions -> mitigation: conservative confidence thresholds and mandatory eval set checks before canary
- risk: increased costs from mis-estimation -> mitigation: start canaries at 1% and automatic rollback on cost increases

Dependencies:
- runtime telemetry ingestion improvements (ENG-33120)
- continuous-profile aggregator infra (ENG-7421)
- eval harness improvements for automated quality checks (ENG-214567)

Deliverables:
- backend services for signature & candidate generation
- shadow validation pipeline and dashboards
- orchestrator for safe apply and rollback with audit trail
- Console surfaces for recommendations and manual override
- runbook for oncall and SRE with rollback playbook

Success metrics (90 days post-release):
- average token cost per request reduced by >= 8% for customers using recommendations
- no customer-visible quality regressions in rollout cohort (0 incidents)
- median time-to-rollback <= 5 minutes for automated triggers
